description: Converts the public web page at an address to PDF, as a browser prints it: the text stays selectable and the links work. The page is opened without a session, so a page behind a login is out of reach. The address is sent to conv2pdf, which opens the page, and the call counts as one conversion.

output_path.description: Where to write the PDF, such as ~/Documents/page.pdf: absolute, or relative to the working directory of the server. An existing file is never overwritten.

url.description: Address of the page, starting with https:// or http://.

name: convert_url_to_pdf
title: Convert Web Page to PDF
